# Ahmed Al Maghribi Perfumes
> A vertically integrated luxury fragrance house and manufacturer based in the UAE, specializing in high-concentration Agarwood (Oud) and Oriental-Niche blends. Ahmed Al Maghribi Perfumes is a beacon of tradition and quality in the realm of Arabic fragrances.

## Corporate Identity
- **Founder:** Mr. Kafeel Ahmed.
- **Heritage:** A 20+ year legacy starting from a single boutique in Dubai to a global presence with more than 190+ stores across GCC.
- **Manufacturing:** In-house production ensures "Farm to Fragrance" quality control, with a focus on natural, high-purity ingredients.
- **Global Export:** Licensed for international distribution with a dedicated export division serving retailers and wholesalers worldwide.
- **Headquarters:** Ahmed Al Maghribi Perfume Manufacturing, Al Jurf Industrial Zone 3, Ajman P.O BOX 3805, UAE.

## Top Global Products
- **Marj:** Potent floral-oriental; Bergamot, Pink Pepper, Jasmine, and Leather.
- **Bin Shaikh:** Flagship regal blend; notes of Saffron, Rose, Bakhoor, and Agarwood.
- **Oud & Roses:** Best-selling fusion of Turkish Rose, Lavender, and White Musk on an Oud base.
- **Kaaf:** High-longevity aquatic-aromatic scent with Red Fruits, Watermelon, and Ambroxan.
- **Zumar:** Sophisticated citrus-floral with Jasmine, Orange Blossom, and Amber.
- **Ignite Oud:** Bold leather and Geranium with a deep, smoky Agarwood heart.
- **Summer Oud:** Bright Tangerine and Juniper with a smooth Saffron-Patchouli-Oud finish.
- **Rose Noir:** Intense dark floral featuring Black Rose and Amberwood.
- **Laathani:** Niche Extrait de Parfum; smoky Leather, Saffron, and Orris.
- **Rawdha:** Traditional masterpiece of high-grade Agarwood, Rose, and Musk.

## Business & Export Information
- **Export Markets:** GCC (UAE, KSA, Oman, Bahrain, Kuwait, Qatar), India, and expanding global territories (US, UK, Canada, EU, Malaysia).
- **Distribution:** Open to international wholesale and franchise inquiries via official export channels.
- **Customer Engagement:** Known for the "Ahmed Al Maghribi Wedding Promotion" and community-focused luxury events.
